mapper.select: SELECT g.game_id, g.name_ko AS name, g.cover_url, g.genre, ug.is_main FROM user_game ug JOIN game g ON g.game_id = ug.game_id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ug.is_main DESC, ug.user_game_id ASC
SELECT user_id FROM `user` WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM game WHERE game_id = #{gameId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_game WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_game SET is_main = FALSE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_main = TRUE
UPDATE user_game SET is_main = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND game_id = #{gameId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_game WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND game_id = #{gameId}
